entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to continue.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit support, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. I think. I tried looking on the website but it was all very confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?

Got it. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Ride helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything. It's just... the color. It looked different online. It's a perfectly good helmet, I'm sure, I just... I won't wear it. Can't you just help me? The online portal was talking about different days and policies, I just got overwhelmed.
I understand, the website can be a lot to take in sometimes. And did you end up using it at all?
Oh, no! The box is unopened, sitting right here. I wouldn't ever use a helmet and then return it, that wouldn't be right for safety.

Of course. I completely understand wanting the right color, and I appreciate you keeping it in new condition. Let me just check the policy against your delivery date... okay. Yes, this is no problem at all.

Absolutely. I see it was delivered 38 days ago, and our standard return policy allows for returns up to 90 days. Since the box is unopened and it's a simple color preference, I can approve this return for you right now and email you a prepaid shipping label.
Oh, thank you so much! That's such a relief. I was so worried it was going to be a big hassle.

Not at all. I've just sent that label to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, Charlie. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
